resources.string: Temperature, humidity, wind and pressure come from the National Weather Service (weather.gov). Stations report about once an hour, so a reading can be an hour or more old. Each card shows when it was taken.
The shading under the stations is drawn from public elevation data (USGS 3DEP, NASA SRTM and other public sources), via AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles.
Heights are in feet, in six bands, with a rule of thumb for how much cooler it usually is up high.
Readings are for general interest, not for safety or aviation decisions.
Ridge / highland: ridge, foothill or mountain terrain, or above 1,640 ft
Station data isn\'t included in this build for this region. Tap the California button at the top right to switch regions.

%1$d of %2$d regions have station data in this build. A region without it shows no stations. Readings for the stations that are shown are live from the National Weather Service.\n\nEach region\'s stations ship in a small data file in the app\'s assets (a.txt to f.txt). A region with none has a missing or damaged file: check Logcat (tag StationPack). To try other data, add stations_<regionId>.csv to app/src/debug/assets and rebuild.
